card.name: Storage and shelf-life wording
card.fires_on: Small words and number gaps inside phrases about how long something lasts or where it is stored, such as 'stored in', 'up to', 'spent days', before a duration or a cool, dry place.

modes.label: Storage location phrasing
modes.description: Words like 'in' or 'a' after 'stored' just before a cool, dry place.
modes.example: it is best placed with a label into a seed packet and stored in<< a>> cool, dry place.

modes.label: Duration phrasing
modes.description: Words or spaces just before a number of hours or days, in freshness or storage timing.
modes.example: and 8°C (36°F to 46°F) for up to<< >>24 hours, while avoiding microbial contamination
